# 08 · ASSETS, BUILD PHASES & QA — Lanthera Health

## 1. Asset Table (all generated by the coding agent; nothing "TBD")
Registry: every asset gets an entry in `assets/manifest.json` (`id, path, prompt, size, status, alt{en,hi}`). Use the **master image-prompt template** from File 02.
| Group | Files (naming) | Sizes | Notes / Procedural fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hero cinematic | `img/hero/hero-01…06.avif/.webp/.jpg` | 1920×1080 (+1200, 768) | Fallback: CSS radial glow + paper-fold SVG pattern |
| Departments | `img/dept/{slug}.avif/.webp` (12) | 1200×1500 (+768, 480) | Fallback: duotone gradient tile with department icon |
| People portraits | `img/people/{id}.avif/.webp` (≈45) | 800×1000 (+400×500) | Fallback: initials on halo ring; label "Fictional" |
| Journey stops | `img/path/{path}-{stop}.avif/.webp` (9+) | 1200×800 | Fallback: illustrated SVG vignette |
| Facilities | `img/facility/{id}.avif/.webp` (8) | 1200×800 | Fallback: gradient + icon |
| Understand illustrations | `img/understand/{slug}.svg/.webp` (20) | 1200×800, 1:1 alt | Illustrations (flat, warm palette), not photographs |
| Night Watch art | `img/nightwatch/{hour}.svg` (12) | 600×400 | SVG vignettes, inline-able |
| Building silhouette | `img/building.svg` | vector | 40 window rects with ids |
| Icons | `img/icons/sprite.svg` (60 icons) | 24px grid | Hand-authored SVG |
| Patterns/textures | `img/pattern/fold.svg`, `grain.png` | 512 tile | Very low opacity |
| OG / social | `og/{page}.png` (5) | 1200×630 | Generated with brand template (text rendered via SVG→PNG script) |
| Fonts | `fonts/*.woff2` | subset | Fraunces, Instrument Sans, JetBrains Mono, Noto Devanagari (Serif + Sans) |
| Video/ambient (optional) | `video/ambient-glow.webm` | ≤ 600KB, 8s loop | Only Tier A; poster image required |
| PDF templates | `pdf/prep-sheet.tsx`, `pdf/cost-sheet.tsx` | A4 | EN + HI |
Rules: AVIF first, WebP fallback, JPEG last; each raster ≤ budget in File 05; alt text always present; generated people are **fictional** and labelled as such in the demo disclosure.

**Logo & favicon files:** `logo-primary.svg`, `logo-mark.svg`, `logo-mono-light.svg`, `logo-mono-dark.svg`, `logo-stacked.svg`, `logo-glow.svg`, `favicon.ico`, `favicon.svg`, `apple-touch-icon.png`, `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png`, `maskable-512.png`, `site.webmanifest`, `safari-pinned-tab.svg`.

## 2. BUILD PHASES

### Phase 0 — SETUP ONLY (define exactly; then STOP and wait for "go")
1. Scaffold project (Vite + React + TS) and initialise **git**.
2. Install dependencies per File 06.
3. Initialise **Tailwind** and **shadcn/ui**.
4. Create **tokens** from File 02 (`tokens.css`, Tailwind mapping) — variables only, no styling of pages.
5. Set up **self-hosted fonts** (files + `@font-face`, no visual application yet).
6. Create the **folder structure** from File 06.
7. Fill `config/site.ts` from File 01.
8. Create `types.ts` from File 06.
9. **i18n skeleton** (en/hi namespaces, empty/placeholder keys, `check:i18n` script).
10. **Router with ALL routes from File 03** as minimal placeholder pages (each shows only its route name).
11. Minimal **layout shell** (unstyled header/main/footer landmarks).
12. Configure **ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, Playwright** (+ axe) and Husky/lint-staged.
13. Add **scripts** from File 06.
14. **First git commit.**
15. Create stubs: `README.md`, `PROGRESS.md`, `SOURCES.md`, `assets/manifest.json`.
16. **Verify:** install ✔ · typecheck ✔ · lint ✔ · build ✔ · dev server boots ✔ · all routes resolve ✔.
> **Phase 0 contains NO real design, NO copy, NO images, NO animations.** Report results, update `PROGRESS.md`, then stop.

### Phase 1 — Foundation & Emergency First
Design system components (buttons, cards, inputs, modal), header/footer, Emergency pill, consent gate, demo banner, theme/language/text-size/Calm controls, **Emergency page** (fast, offline-cached). *Exit:* Emergency reachable in 1 click on every route; a11y checks pass.

### Phase 2 — Brand & Home Hero
Logo/favicons, fonts applied, hero imagery, Home hero + route tiles, page transitions ("Light passes"), loader, cursor, scroll progress.

### Phase 3 — Lantern Guide (highest utility)
Rule table, flow, result, PDF prep sheet (EN/HI), tests for red-flag logic.

### Phase 4 — The Night Watch + Home story
SVG building, GSAP story, static fallback, mobile tier.

### Phase 5 — The Path + Waiting Room Live
Five journeys, drawer details, printable checklist; board simulator + TV layout.

### Phase 6 — Departments, Doctors & Circle of Care
Data, listing/detail pages, filters, constellation + accessible tree view, doctor profiles, booking mock.

### Phase 7 — Clear Ledger, Packages, International
Estimator, glossary, PDF cost sheet, packages compare, international page.

### Phase 8 — Lantern Portal & Diagnostics
Portal shell, dashboard, reports viewer with glossary chips, bills, timeline, messages.

### Phase 9 — Understand (Knowledge Hub)
Three-layer article template, 20 articles (EN/HI), search, print styles, sources.

### Phase 10 — About, Careers, Contact, Legal, 404
Remaining pages and legal/disclosure content.

### Phase 11 — Polish, Performance & QA
Motion polish, performance tuning to budgets, full a11y audit, cross-browser/device tests, SEO/JSON-LD, PWA, content proofreading (EN/HI), asset manifest completeness, `DEMO_SCRIPT.md`.

## 3. Definition of Done
**Visual**
- [ ] Matches File 02 tokens/typography; both themes polished; no cliché imagery
- [ ] Responsive at 360, 390, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536, 1920 px; no horizontal scroll
- [ ] Every image has a fallback; no empty boxes; consistent radii/spacing

**Function**
- [ ] All 8 signature features work per File 04 including edge cases
- [ ] Emergency pill on every route; command palette covers all pages
- [ ] Language/theme/Calm/text-size persist correctly; forms validate; PDFs render EN/HI
- [ ] Print styles OK for Path, Guide, Ledger

**Content**
- [ ] No lorem/TBD; EN/HI parity (CI check passes); all names/data fictional and labelled
- [ ] Disclaimers present per File 01 §5.3; no forbidden claims (testimonials, outcomes, superlatives)
- [ ] `SOURCES.md` complete for every factual claim

**Performance / A11y / SEO**
- [ ] Lighthouse mobile: Perf ≥ 90, A11y ≥ 98, BP ≥ 95, SEO ≥ 95 on all key pages
- [ ] LCP ≤ 2.0s (Emergency ≤ 1.2s), CLS ≤ 0.02, INP ≤ 150ms; JS budgets met
- [ ] WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard, focus visible, contrast, reduced motion, screen-reader spot checks, target size ≥ 24px (goal 44px)
- [ ] JSON-LD valid, sitemap/robots/hreflang correct, `noindex` while demo

**Engineering**
- [ ] Typecheck/lint/unit/e2e/a11y all green in CI; no console errors
- [ ] No unused deps; bundle analysed; README complete; white-label swap tested (change brand in config → site rebrands)

## 4. `DEMO_SCRIPT.md` — 7-Minute Pitch Flow
| Time | Show | Say (intent) |
|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:30 | Home hero + demo banner | "Imagine a family arriving at 2 a.m. What do they need first?" (Emergency pill visible) |
| 0:30–1:30 | Night Watch scroll | "This is who is awake for them — no claims, just truth." |
| 1:30–2:45 | Lantern Guide → PDF | "Two minutes, and they leave with a plan they can hand to the front desk." |
| 2:45–3:45 | The Path + Waiting Room Live | "What happens next, and how the wait feels lighter." |
| 3:45–4:45 | Clear Ledger | "No billing surprises — ranges, glossary, questions to ask." |
| 4:45–5:30 | Circle of Care + Doctor profile | "Accountability is visible: who leads, who they'll meet." |
| 5:30–6:15 | Lantern Portal + Understand | "After care: reports made understandable." |
| 6:15–6:45 | Language + theme + Calm Mode + ⌘K | "Built for every visitor, every language, every mood." |
| 6:45–7:00 | Close on "The light stays on." | "Everything you just saw is config-driven and ready to be made yours." |
**Backup plan:** if a feature fails live, jump via ⌘K to the next; keep offline build ready.
